Indikator 8 tracks the fulfillment of a specific healthcare quality standard across Danish regions and health clusters (sundhedsklynger), with a stated target of ≥50% [^src1] [^src3]. The data covers three consecutive periods—2021/22, 2022/23, and 2023/24—revealing a landscape of significant regional disparities and general, albeit uneven, improvement over time [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

**Targets Met and Missed**
Across all measured periods and administrative levels, [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] stands out as the absolute leader and the only entity to successfully meet the ≥50% target [^src1] [^src3]. In the 2022/23 period, Midtklyngen achieved a fulfillment rate of 57.5% [^src1], and it further improved to 62.1% in 2023/24 [^src3]. In stark contrast, the national average for Denmark remained well below the target, rising from 8.2% in 2021/22 [^src1] to 16.3% in 2022/23 [^src3], and reaching 19.2% in 2023/24 [^src3]. Every other region and cluster missed the 50% threshold in all recorded years [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

**Leaders and Trailers**
Following Midtklyngen, the highest-performing clusters in the most recent 2023/24 period include [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] at 40.7% [^src3], [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] at 40.3% [^src3], and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 36.7% [^src3]. At the bottom of the rankings, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] consistently records the lowest regional fulfillment, at 3.6% in 2022/23 [^src1] and 4.3% in 2023/24 [^src3]. Among the smaller clusters, [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] recorded the lowest overall value in 2023/24 at just 0.1% [^src3], while [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] reported 0.0% in 2022/23 [^src1].

**Trends Over Time**
The data indicates a strong upward trend for most administrative units between 2021/22 and 2023/24. For example, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] saw its fulfillment rate surge from 2.5% in 2021/22 [^src1] to 17.8% in 2023/24 [^src3]. Similarly, [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] jumped from a mere 0.2% in 2021/22 [^src1] to 21.7% in 2023/24 [^src3]. However, not all clusters sustained this growth. [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]] experienced a gradual decline, dropping from 28.4% in 2021/22 [^src1] to 24.1% in 2022/23 [^src1], and slipping slightly to 23.9% in 2023/24 [^src3]. [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] also saw a minor regression, peaking at 42.0% in 2022/23 [^src1] before falling to 40.3% in 2023/24 [^src3].

**Outliers**
Beyond its exceptional performance, [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] is also a methodological outlier. In the 2022/23 dataset, it is the only entity marked as "Ja" for "Uoplyst" (unknown/missing data status), while all other regions and clusters are marked "Nej" [^src1]. Despite this flag, its reported fulfillment rate of 57.5% was still calculated and recorded [^src1]. Furthermore, the gap between Midtklyngen (62.1%) and the national average (19.2%) in 2023/24 highlights an extreme concentration of Indikator 8 compliance within a single health cluster [^src3].
